name: confidence-check
description: Teaches agents metacognitive self-evaluation before delivering output. Score confidence 0-100 using structured rubric, audit output for hedging phrases and unsupported assertions, detect self-contradictions, and flag uncertainty with verification steps. Activates before complex responses, in high-consequence domains, or when delivering uncertain output. Do NOT use for trivial yes/no answers, factual lookups with direct evidence, or routine single-step operations.
